श्रौत (तं) 1.
n. Preservation of the
sacred fire; observance appoint-
ed by the
Vedas. f. Comparison
indicated by a particle.
a. Relat-
ing to hearing or to the
Vedas.

श्रौत-स्मार्त्त-क्रिया (या) 1.
f. A deed
sanctioned by law and religion.

श्रौत-स्मार्त्त-धर्म्म (र्म्मः) 1.
m. A duty so
sanctioned.

श्रौत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. Conversancy with
the
Vedas; the ear.

interj. Exclamation on offer-
ing by fire to gods or manes.
